{{Top|canon=Modulated laserfire}}
A '''modulated laser''' was employed as an alternative form of communication when conventional types were not available. It was solely a visual form with no speech involved. The beams received from the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] were interpreted and translated by a demodulator.
